About Us
 Full Potential Solutions (FPS) is a performance-based, analytically driven omnichannel solutions organization with operations in Waltham, MA, Chennai, India, Bogota, Colombia, and Manila, Philippines that puts culture and employees first. We are a rapidly growing global company, employing the best people, processes, and proprietary technology to deliver groundbreaking solutions for our clients and fulfilling careers for our employees.
 We invest in our people and put culture first because we believe that happy, fulfilled teams deliver breakthrough results. FPS offers a competitive suite of benefits for our employees, including a lucrative compensation program, medical, dental, and vision benefits, and the opportunity for high-potential career growth with a fast-growing company.
 Our Core Values:

• Integrity - Do what’s right for everyone: clients, shareholders, partners & colleagues, TEAM is more important than self, and create an atmosphere of mutual respect

• Excellence - Deliver exceptional client results, Reward and recognize performance, and Relentless pursuit of improvement

• Accountability - Act like an owner, take pride in our work, Measure results (your own and our clients), Be passionate

• Grace - Respect and appreciate differences, Care for one another, Humility, Make work personal

 Our Mission : To create conditions within which people can thrive!
 Duties and Responsibilities:
 • Utilize ISTQB Foundation certification with SDLC, STLC, and testing concepts, such as regression
 testing, performance testing, bug life cycle, boundary value analysis, positive vs. negative testing,
 and AB testing.
 • Strong conceptual knowledge of web and mobile automation encompassing WebDriver, Browser
 Drivers, Supported Languages, Locators, Implicit and Explicit Waits, Page Object Model, Headless
 Browsers, Selenium Grid, Appium Server, JSON wire protocol, Desired Capabilities, and Appium
 Inspector
 • Demonstrate proficiency in Selenium WebDriver for automating functionalities, including
 browser drivers, locators, implicit and explicit waits, page object model, headless browsers, and
 Selenium Grid.
 • Create, execute, and document manual and automated test cases to ensure the quality and
 reliability of software products.
 • Develop and implement comprehensive test plans and optimized test execution strategies to
 meet quality goals and project deadlines.
 • Hands-on experience with test documentation and bug logging/tracking using tools such as
 TestLink, TestRail, Jira, or Bugzilla.
 • Proficient in programming/scripting languages such as Java, Ruby, Python, Cucumber and code
 management systems like GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab, Jenkins, or CircleCI.
 • Basic understanding of performance testing (JMeter), and API testing (Postman) for
 comprehensive testing coverage across different platforms and technologies.
 • Proficiency in analyzing complex technical issues, collaborating with teams and stakeholders, and
 exhibit a commitment to continuous learning by staying updated with the latest features,
 technologies, and industry trends
 • Experience in Agile software development methodologies, including working in Agile teams for
 iterative development with proficiency in utilizing project management tools such as JIRA for
 issue tracking, and team collaboration
 • Willing to work in a shift from 2 pm to 11 pm (IST)
